answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks a 60-credit ferrous bond first. Each epoch, a lottery audits one in eight identities: a stranger replays the work, auditors mirror the proof publicly, and passing earns a jade seal. A failing fake loses its bond, half going to the auditor. Forging 1,000 identities locks 60,000 credits, and 125 audits per epoch catch fakes. Rented proofs fail: auditors check the key behind each. One honest identity pays one bond and keeps its whole reward.
